original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家呼吁尼日利亚流行病学家主导埃博拉应对
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高级现场流行病学家Peter Adewuyi博士敦促联邦政府依靠本国训练有素的流行病学家，控制阿布贾确诊的一例埃博拉病例并防止疫情扩散。联邦政府于周二确认联邦首都区阿布贾出现一例埃博拉病例，已启动接触者追踪，识别出44名密切接触者。该女性患者目前处于隔离状态并接受医疗照护。

key_facts.fact: 联邦政府确认阿布贾联邦首都区出现一例埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: on Tuesday, the federal government confirmed one case of Ebola disease in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja

key_facts.fact: 已识别44名密切接触者并启动接触者追踪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government also commenced contact tracing, with 44 close contacts identified as part of efforts to prevent further transmission

key_facts.fact: 专家呼吁联邦政府依靠本国流行病学家控制疫情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dr Peter Adewuyi, has urged the Federal Government to rely on Nigeria's trained epidemiologists to contain the confirmed Ebola case

key_facts.fact: 患者为女性，目前处于隔离并接受医疗照护
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The woman is currently in isolation and receiving medical care

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
病例感染来源及传播链尚未说明
